description: Route canary for the shared guard. Two fixed benign requests: one plain, one native tool call with tool_choice=auto (the lab wire shape). DeepSeek stages: s0-key, s0-canary, s0-canary-sdk. OpenAI stages live under provider_stages: s0-key-openai, s1-openai-canary (RUN-PLAN-OPENAI.md).

s0-key.description: Key check, run before anything else: exactly one plain request (the canary's 'pong' prompt) with max_tokens clamped to 1 by the guard. Confirms the key, the model id and the thinking-disabled wire on real DeepSeek at the smallest possible cost. The receipt shows status completed with halt_reason request_cap_reached, because the single allowed request uses the whole request cap.

estimate.tokens: about 27 (UNVERIFIED for DeepSeek; the same prompt was 26 prompt tokens with qwen2.5's tokenizer in the 2026-10-08 Ollama dry runs, plus 1 completion token)
estimate.usd: about 0.00001 at the 2026-09-30 lab snapshot (UNVERIFIED); the guard reserves about 0.00003 before sending

s0-key.compares_to: lab DeepSeek wire contract (packages/agentdojo-lab/configs/cross_model_pilot_v2.json providers[deepseek]); pass = HTTP 200, usage_source provider, completion_tokens <= 1

s0-canary.description: Two requests through the guard with the standard-library client.

s0-canary-sdk.description: Same two requests through the openai SDK; run the runner with an artifact venv python that has openai installed.
s0-canary-sdk.compares_to: lab DeepSeek wire contract (as s0-canary), exercised through the openai SDK the artifacts use

s0-key-openai.description: OpenAI key check, run before any other OpenAI stage: exactly one plain request (the canary's 'pong' prompt) to gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, the cheapest model in the plan. The canary sends max_tokens 16; the guard clamps it to 1 and ledgers max_tokens_field max_tokens. Confirms the key, the exact model id, the Standard service tier and provider-reported usage. The receipt shows status completed with halt_reason request_cap_reached, because the single allowed request uses the whole request cap.

estimate.tokens: about 21 (UNVERIFIED for OpenAI's tokenizer; the same prompt measured 20 prompt + 1 completion tokens on deepseek-flash in common/s0-key, 20261008-deepseek-auditor-smoke-v1)
estimate.usd: about 0.000004 at gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 $0.15/M input, $0.60/M output (providers.json, fetched 2026-10-08); the guard reserves about 0.00002 before sending

s0-key-openai.compares_to: providers.json openai wire contract; pass = HTTP 200, usage_source provider, response_model gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, service_tier absent or default, completion_tokens <= 1

s1-openai-canary.description: OpenAI route smoke over every model the OpenAI fidelity stages use: per chat model one plain request (max_completion_tokens) and one native tool call (max_tokens; max_completion_tokens for gpt-5.2), one logprobs request (top_logprobs 5) on gpt-4.1-mini, and one embeddings request (2 short inputs) on text-embedding-3-large: 10 checked requests. Then 2 wire probes on gpt-5.2 (the plain request with max_tokens, and with temperature 0) that answer RUN-PLAN-OPENAI.md open issue 3; a probe may return HTTP 400 (charged $0 by the guard, UNVERIFIED) and does not fail the canary. 12 requests. Checks that each exact id is served under its own name on the Standard tier, that both output-limit fields, tool calls, logprobs and embeddings pass the guard unchanged, and that usage (including cached_tokens) is reported.

estimate.tokens: about 1,600 (UNVERIFIED; per chat model about 300 prompt + at most 80 completion, scaled from the 2 canary requests on deepseek-flash: 301 prompt + 48 completion in common/s0-canary-sdk; embeddings about 20; the 2 gpt-5.2 probes about 30 prompt + at most 16 completion each)
estimate.usd: about 0.006 (UNVERIFIED): gpt-4o-2024-05-13 about 0.003, gpt-5.2 about 0.0016 + about 0.0006 for the 2 probes, gpt-4.1-mini about 0.0003, gpt-4o-mini about 0.0001, embeddings < 0.00001 at providers.json prices

s1-openai-canary.compares_to: providers.json openai wire contract; pass = all 10 checked requests HTTP 200 (the 2 probes record an answer, 200 or 400, and are not pass/fail), every response model equals the requested id, service_tier absent or default, tool calls parse as JSON, the logprobs request returns 5 top_logprobs per token, embeddings return 2 vectors with usage.prompt_tokens
